conclusion: Owner confirms English/German Space recognition using the built-in microphone and speakers in a slightly noisy room, live draft updates in both languages, draft correction before explicit Submit and Stop mic during a hold. Selector/permission details, finalization/release, Whisper and remaining lifecycle/device/echo cases stay open.

cases.name: Basic live English and German recognition through held Space
cases.notes: Owner reports recognition working in English and German through Space hold-to-talk; subsequent intake confirms the built-in microphone/speakers in a slightly noisy room. Accuracy is unmeasured and selector usage remains unspecified.

cases.name: Basic held-Space interaction
cases.notes: Qualitative acceptance of the instructed interaction; individual focus/lifecycle cases are not inferred.

cases.name: Permission and device/route intake
cases.notes: Owner identifies the MacBook Pro built-in microphone and built-in speakers. Selector usage and the OS microphone permission host identity remain unreported.

cases.name: English partial/final observation, correction and explicit Submit
cases.notes: Manual draft correction before explicit Submit works, with the correction language unspecified. Owner separately confirms live draft updates in English; final text after release remains unreported.

cases.name: German partial/final observation, correction and explicit Whisper
cases.notes: Owner confirms live draft updates in German. Final text after release, German-specific correction and explicit Whisper submission remain unreported.

cases.name: Tap typing, release and no automatic submission
cases.notes: Separately confirm short taps type spaces and release stops capture without sending.

cases.name: Stop, close and language-switch cancellation
cases.notes: Stop mic during held Space works. Close and language-switch cancellation were not reported.

cases.name: External app focus loss and recovery
cases.notes: Switch to another app while holding; return, release and start a fresh hold.

cases.name: Successful save/load while key held
cases.notes: Requires a disposable save context; existing reset-seam automation is not this physical test.

cases.name: Input loss and recovery
cases.notes: Requires an appropriate removable input and owner-enabled device change; no such action performed.

cases.name: Permission denial and recovery
cases.notes: No OS permission revocation/change performed or assumed authorized.

cases.name: Quiet/noisy speech and accent conditions
cases.notes: Successful English/German recognition was reported in a slightly noisy room using the built-in microphone and speakers. Noise level and recognition accuracy were not measured. Separate quiet-room and accent conditions remain unreported.

cases.name: Headphone reply interruption
cases.notes: With Speak replies on, hold Space during a reply; separately test Listen only with headphones.

cases.name: Speaker feedback/echo
cases.notes: Owner confirms built-in speaker output during the recognition trial. Overlapping reply playback, feedback and echo behavior were not reported; a separate case remains required. Energy/VAD cancellation is not echo cancellation.

cases.name: Offline operation/network failure
cases.notes: No physical network setting change performed; local architecture alone is not an offline test.

prior_automated_evidence: Reuse published Space verification for synthetic/native checks. These are not physical session passes.
